chunks: "Did I not tell you," he replied, "that you will not be able to bear with me?"
ai.seo_question: What did Khidr say to remind his companion about his patience?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Kahf (18:75), Al-Khidh reminds Musa (AS) of his initial warning that he would not be able to maintain patience with him, emphasizing the necessity of trusting divine wisdom over immediate perception. Shia scholars often highlight this as a key moment illustrating the distinction between apparent chaos and hidden order, a theme central to the concept of *Hikmah* (divine wisdom) and the patience required to accept God's decrees even when their rationale is not immediately visible.
